arguments.sql:
SELECT ml.city AS city, ml.state AS state, COUNT(*) AS fraud_count
FROM transactions t
JOIN fraud_labels f ON f.transaction_id = CAST(t.id AS TEXT)
JOIN merchant_locations ml ON ml.id = t.merchant_location_id
WHERE f.is_fraud = 1
GROUP BY ml.city, ml.state
ORDER BY fraud_count DESC, ml.city, ml.state
arguments.explanation: Counts of labelled fraud transactions grouped by merchant city and state, largest first. Online transactions appear as their own row.
assumptions: Fraud means fraud_labels.is_fraud = 1; only labelled transactions are counted.
Location is the transaction's merchant location (merchant_location_id), read as city together with state.
Online transactions (city 'ONLINE', empty state) are kept as a separate row rather than removed.
Covers the full data range, 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31.
